child_list.content: A Foreign Friend
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: I have a foreign friend named Anna. She is from England. We met in a language class at school. Anna has long brown hair and blue eyes. She is very friendly and funny. We like to play soccer and read books together. Anna teaches me English and I teach her Chinese. Sometimes, we also share stories about our families and festivals. Anna tells me about Christmas in England, and I tell her about the Spring Festival in China. We enjoy learning about each other’s cultures. Even though we are from different places, we are good friends.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

child_list.content: 一个外国朋友
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 我有一个外国朋友叫安娜。她来自英国。我们是在学校的语言课上认识的。安娜有着棕色的长发和蓝色的眼睛。她非常友好，也很有趣。我们喜欢一起踢足球和读书。安娜教我英语，我教她汉语。有时候，我们也会分享家庭和节日的故事。安娜给我讲英国的圣诞节，我给她讲中国的春节。我们喜欢了解彼此的文化。虽然我们来自不同的地方，但我们是好朋友。
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
